prompt: A compound shows IR bands at 3300 (sharp), 2100 (weak). What functional group is present?
explanation: Terminal alkynes have a sharp ≡C–H stretch at ~3300 and a weak C≡C stretch at ~2100. Internal alkynes have no sp C–H and often invisible C≡C (no dipole change). Nitriles are sharper and higher (~2250).
